"8. Optional payment — supplement of 17 October 2026. Seller: individual entrepreneur Sergey Olegovich Efremov (ИП Ефремов Сергей Олегович); INN 471905964680; OGRNIP 326470400141351. Where purchases are enabled for the app version and region, all advertising can be removed permanently for one payment of 149 RUB, without a subscription. When you open settings or the purchase section, the app checks availability with the server. You enter payment details and email in the Robokassa form; the diary code does not read them from that form. The Cloudflare Workers/D1 server stores the invoice number, random order and license identifiers, access token hash, store and mode, merchant identifier, amount, currency, status, timestamps and signed license. D1 does not store diary entries, health data, Google data, email or card details. Robokassa notifications may contain email or payment account information: these may pass through the server during verification, but are not used for the license or saved to D1. Cloudflare processes the IP address to determine the country and limit requests; the original IP is not stored in D1, application logs are disabled, and the platform’s own processing is governed by its policy. The license travels with settings in Google Drive sync and JSON backups and is not technically bound to a Google account. Do not publish complete backups. The recovery secret for an unfinished payment stays only in the app’s private device storage and is excluded from those backups. After verifying a license, the app stops its own advertising requests and releases advertising objects; this does not guarantee that all background activity of a previously initialized SDK stops. Clearing the diary does not remove a server order or records that Robokassa and the seller are required to keep. Order data supports license preservation and restoration, accounting and applicable obligations; there is no single fixed retention period. Privacy, data deletion and technical support: pokimoha.123@gmail.com; payments and refunds: pokimoha.2010@mail.ru, telephone +79062280570, terms: https://diet.efreitor2001.ru/offer/ . Provider policies: https://robokassa.com/privacy-policy/ and https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/ ."
